responsibility: Is the public M-profile Vector Extension intrinsic header that exposes the large ACLE MVE API to C/C++ users. It enforces feature and endianness constraints, includes the MVE type header, and then defines the user-facing intrinsic namespace through a large set of macro overload shims and generic-selection helpers that map polymorphic MVE operations, predicated forms, and memory accesses to the corresponding backend builtins.
